welcome.headline: Try everything on before you wear it.
welcome.value: Wardrobe, AI stylist and packing in one app.
welcome.legal: By continuing you accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

auth.subtitle: Your wardrobe, looks and packing lists, on every device.
auth.name: Name

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter the email address of your account. We'll send you a link to renew your password; the link opens the app.
forgot.note: The link works once and is valid for a short time. If you signed in with Apple or Google, you don't need a password.
forgot.sentBody: We sent a password reset link to {{email}}. Tap the link to open Droblet and set your new password.
forgot.sentHint: If the email hasn't arrived, check your junk folder.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.body: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

style.title: Let's get to know you
style.body: Weekly edits and suggestions are built on these choices. You can change them any time.
style.tagsFull: 3 tags selected; remove one to change.
style.tagsLabel: 3 tags that describe your style best
style.tagsLimit: You can choose up to 3 tags.

segmentStep.title: Which department should we style you from?
segmentStep.body: Weekly edits, style tags and the ready-made library follow this choice. You can change it any time in Profile › Style profile.
segmentStep.note: This only shapes your suggestions; it isn't shown on your profile or shared with anyone. You can add anything to your wardrobe.

styleProfile.title: Style profile
styleProfile.segmentNote: Suggestions, edits and the ready-made library come from this department. Your wardrobe stays the same.
styleProfile.confirmBody: Suggestions and the ready-made library change with it; your wardrobe stays the same.
styleProfile.confirmNote: You pick your style tags again for the new department. If your body type isn't in it, we'll ask once more.

body.title: Let's see outfits on you
body.body: Add your height and 1–3 full-length photos; we'll show products and suggestions as they look on you.
body.cameraOff: Camera access is off. To take photos, allow camera access for Droblet in Settings, or choose from your library.
body.privacy: Your photos and the images generated on you are visible only to you. You can delete them any time in Profile › Privacy.
body.heightInvalid: Enter a height between 120 and 220 cm.
body.weightInvalid: Enter a weight between 30 and 250 kg, or leave it empty.
body.photoFailed: That photo couldn't be prepared. Try another one.

permission.cameraBody: We need the camera so you can take your full-length photo. Your photos are visible only to you.
permission.photosBody: We need access so you can pick a photo from your library. We only take the photo you choose.
permission.cameraDeniedBody: Turn camera access on in Settings, or choose a photo from your library.
permission.photosDeniedBody: Turn photo access on in Settings, or take the photo with your camera.

firstItems.title: Which of these are in your wardrobe?
firstItems.body: Tap to select; no photo needed. Your first outfit suggestion is built with these pieces.
firstItems.cameraBody: Add with the camera, AI recognises it
firstItems.empty: The ready-made library is empty right now.

pushAsk.title: We'll let you know when your morning outfit is ready
pushAsk.body: We only write when it helps; no buzzing all day.
pushAsk.bodyTeen: We only write about your morning outfit and your results; never about campaigns.
pushAsk.morningBody: Every morning, before you get dressed
pushAsk.weeklyBody: Sunday evening, to plan your new week
pushAsk.resultBody: We'll tell you as soon as the image is done
pushAsk.settingsHint: You can change this anytime in Settings.

paywall.title: Droblet Membership
paywall.tagline: An outfit ready every morning. A suitcase ready for every trip.
paywall.benefitAiBody: See products and outfits on your own photo
paywall.benefitStylistBody: A daily outfit for your plans and the weather
paywall.benefitPackingBody: Packing list and daily looks by city and dates
paywall.benefitPaletteBody: The shades that suit your face best
paywall.finePrintTrialYear: After the free trial you pay {{price}} a year. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your {{store}} account settings.
paywall.finePrintTrialMonth: After the free trial you pay {{price}} a month. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your {{store}} account settings.
paywall.finePrintYear: {{price}} a year. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your {{store}} account settings.
paywall.finePrintMonth: {{price}} a month. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your {{store}} account settings.
paywall.renewalTrial: After the trial you'll be charged {{price}}. Unless cancelled, the subscription renews automatically at the end of each period.
paywall.renewal: You'll be charged {{price}}. Unless cancelled, the subscription renews automatically at the end of each period.

subscription.title: Manage membership
subscription.freeBody: Become a member to see products and outfits on your own photo, and for the personal stylist and smart packing.
subscription.storeNote: Membership is billed through your store account. Cancel or change your plan in the store's subscription settings.
subscription.storeLinkFailed: The store settings couldn't be opened. You can open your subscription settings from the store app.

photoSource.bodyCaption: Plain background, full length. The most realistic try-on.
photoSource.bodyFull: You have three full-length photos; remove one to add another.
photoSource.faceCaption: For your colour palette and a quick try-on. Replaces the current one.
photoSource.footnote: We ask for your explicit consent before the first full-length and face photo. Your photos are visible only to you.
photoSource.onbBodyCaption_one: Plain background, full length. You can choose {{count}} photo from your library.
photoSource.onbBodyCaption_other: Plain background, full length. You can choose up to {{count}} photos from your library.
photoSource.onbFaceCaption: In daylight, facing the camera. Unlocks your colour palette and a quick try-on.
